message: A steel roof truss spans 18m with 6 equal panels and a constant 3m height. Provide verticals at every panel point and alternating web diagonals: left-bottom to right-top in panels 1, 3, and 5, and left-top to right-bottom in panels 2, 4, and 6. Use a pinned support at the left bottom node and a horizontal roller free in global X at the right bottom node. Apply a 12kN downward load at each interior top-chord node and run static analysis.
